label: Recorded evidence: $ZED_CUSTOM_type
command: dxn review "$ZED_RELATIVE_FILE" "$ZED_CUSTOM_type" | while IFS= read -r line; do case "$line" in "Wrote "*) zed "${line#Wrote }";; *) echo "$line";; esac; done

label: Stale evidence: $ZED_CUSTOM_type
command: dxn review "$ZED_RELATIVE_FILE" "$ZED_CUSTOM_type" --stale | while IFS= read -r line; do case "$line" in "Wrote "*) zed "${line#Wrote }";; *) echo "$line";; esac; done
